text.tspan: Same semantic IR · Post-LayerNorm · independent layer parameters
Solid edges: model forward · dashed edge: explanatory probability conversion
Hidden snapshot after ReLU · FFN dropout folded
Local detail: top → bottom · dropout / NaN guard folded
Hidden snapshot after ReLU · FFN dropout folded
Local detail: top → bottom · dropout / NaN guard folded
Local detail: top → bottom · dropout / NaN guard folded
Tensor glyphs are symbolic: Q blue · K green · V pink. Same glyph type ≠ shared parameters.
Masks: boolean True → −∞ before attention softmax. Decoder causal mask must be supplied by caller.
Dropout and fully-masked-row NaN guard are folded; retained in semantic_ir.json. ReLU is the source activation.
Macro flow ↑; expanded attention detail ↓ with explicit side rails. This view does not show the generation loop.
